cmd.goToDefinition: XBSL: go to definition, or to its documentation
cmd.metadata.groupMode: XBSL: tree grouping (by class / by subsystem)
config.linter.run: When to run the xbsl linter for .xbsl.
config.linter.run.enum.0: Lint as you type (debounced) and on save
config.linter.run.enum.1: Lint only on save and open
config.linter.run.enum.2: No automatic linting (only the "XBSL: check the whole project" command)
config.linter.command: The xbsl executable, when it is not on PATH. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/start)
config.linter.pythonPath: The Python interpreter to run the engine as a module. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/start)
config.linter.dataDir: The folder with the generated 1C:Element language data. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/start#language-data)
config.linter.lang.enum.0: Follow the display language of the editor
config.linter.debounce: Delay in milliseconds before linting as you type (the onType mode).
config.workspaceLint: On save, check the whole project - that is what cross-file rules need. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#settings)
config.workspaceLintTimeout: How long a whole-project run may take before it is stopped, in milliseconds. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#settings)
config.projectRoot: The sources folder, when the project is not the whole workspace folder. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#settings)
config.baseline: The file with findings excluded from the report. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/linting#baseline-adopt-a-rule-on-a-legacy-codebase)
config.templates.file: The file with your own code templates. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/scaffolding#code-templates)
config.checkForUpdates: Check Open VSX once a day for a newer extension and mark it in the status bar. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode)
config.lsp.enabled: Work through the long-living language server: hover, completion and navigation. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/servers#lsp-server)
config.lsp.command: The command that starts the language server, when the default one does not fit. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/servers#lsp-server)
config.rules: Every rule in one table: the key is a rule (`style/naming`), a group (`style`), a tier letter (`A`) or `*` for all of them; the value is `off` or a level. Priority runs from the specific to the general: rule → group → tier → `*`. A level on a RULE key also switches it on when it is off by default; on a group, a tier or `*` it only recolours what already runs. `{"*": "off"}` reads as "only the ones listed here". [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#rules-levels-and-disabling)
config.deploy.elemctlPath: The elemctl executable - used by the deploy command and by debugging. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#deploy)
config.deploy.envFile: The `.env` that picks the stand: the connection and the default application. Used by both the deploy and debugging (a launch configuration wins). A relative path is resolved against the workspace folder. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#deploy)
config.deploy.appId: The application ON THAT stand: its identifier or exact name (this is not an address). Overrides `ELEMENT_APP_ID` from the .env - leave it empty when the .env already names the application. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#deploy)
debugger.label: 1C:Element (XBSL)
attach.appId: Element application id (app-id). Empty: ELEMENT_APP_ID from .env of the sources root is used.
attach.authMode: Authentication mode of the debuggee application (default: regular sign-in).
attach.stopOnEntry: Stop on the first line of every thread. Noisy on a live web application (every server call pauses); prefer breakpoints.
attach.workspace: Sources root: the directory that contains <Vendor>/<Name>/Project.yaml. Empty: detected automatically from the opened folder.
attach.envFile: Path to a .env file with Console API credentials (elemctl --env-file). Empty: .env of the sources root.
config.debug.adapterPath: The platform debug adapter directory from your 1C:Element distribution. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#debugging)
config.debug.javaPath: Path to the Java executable (JDK 17+). Default: `java` from PATH. Example: `C:/Program Files/Java/jdk-21/bin/java.exe`.
config.debug.openApplicationOnStart: Open the debuggee application in the browser when the session starts (with debug session parameters).
snippet.attach.label: 1C:Element: debug an application (attach)
snippet.attach.description: Attach to an Element application via elemctl + the platform adapter
initial.attach.name: Debug 1C:Element application
config.debug.applicationUrl: Where to open the application under debug, when it answers on a domain of its own. [Details](https://docs.keyfire.ru/xbsl/vscode#debugging)
